_about: Public-domain S. S. Schmucker (Samuel Simon Schmucker, 1799-1873, Lutheran, Gettysburg Seminary) for the Word Hoard: American Lutheranism Vindicated (Project Gutenberg, 1856), and from Internet Archive scans Elements of Popular Theology (first edition, 1834), the Fraternal Appeal for Catholic Union (1838-39), The Papal Hierarchy (1845), The American Lutheran Church (1851), Lutheran Manual on Scriptural Principles (1855), The Church of the Redeemer (1867), The True Unity of Christ's Church (1870), his Catechism (1871) and seven discourses, 1830-1853. Leader of 'American Lutheranism', which revised the Augsburg Confession; veto point. Not Samuel Mosheim or Beale M. Schmucker. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 19 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
